payload.claim: This method is named `resolve_repo`, but `.saffron/specs/SA-0017-saffron-queue-prints-it.md` (already committed, depends transitively on this spec via SA-0016) instructs its implementer to pass the repo id to `build_queue` via `ledger.resolve_repo_id` — never `upsert_repo`. That committed spec text is a documented contract naming the exact call the next task will make; as written, SA-0017's agent will hit an AttributeError calling a method that does not exist, burning an attempt on a naming drift between sibling specs of the same split rather than delivering a fix, and either this name or SA-0017's text needs to be reconciled before that task runs.
